newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Another Belgian to head U.N. force in E. Slavonia.
newsitem.headline: Another Belgian to head U.N. force in E. Slavonia.

text.p: Major-General Willy Hanset of Belgium is succeeding Major-General Jozef Schoups, a fellow countryman, as commander of the 5,000-strong U.N. force in Eastern Slavonia, the United Nations said on Friday.

The force, which includes some 820 Belgian troops, is part of the U.N. Transitional Administration for Eastern Slavonia (UNTAES) preparing the Serb-held region of Croatia for a return to Croatian rule. Elections are scheduled for March 16.
Schoups completed his tour of duty on January 15 and Hanset's appointment was confirmed in an exchange of letters between Secretary-General Kofi Annan and the president of the Security Council.
The U.N. special representative in overall charge of UNTAES is General Jacques Klein of the United States.
